Page | 1  
 
Assam Schedule VIII, Form No. 127 
High Court Criminal Form No. (M) 106 
ORDER SHEET 
IN THE COURT OF CIVIL JUDGE (SENIOR DIVISION) 
SEPPA, EAST KAMENG DISTRICT, ARUNACHAL PRADESH 
 
Civ. Miscellaneous application No. 64/2025 
In Succession Application No. 70/2025 
Shri Kano Aka - Applicant 
Date 
Order 
Signature 
 
17.12.2025 
 
This civil Miscellaneous application being registered as 
No. 64/2025 filed under section 378 of the Indian Succession 
Act, 1925 read with section 151 of CPC by the applicant Shri 
Kano Aka thorugh his learned counsel Mr Darmong Lamgu 
with a prayer for amendment of succession application No. 
70/2025 with incorporating car insurance policy No. 
201130020224850053500000 for the purpose of o claiming 
the car insurance amount approx. Rs. 22,13, 925/-to claim 
debt and securities of deceased Saju Aka. 
Heard Mr Darmong Lamgu the learned counsel for the 
applciant and his prayer for withdrawal of the Civil Misc. case 
No. 64/2025 with liberty to file afresh is hereby allowed. 
 With this Civil Misc. case No. 64/2025 stands disposed 
of on withdrawal. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
(Damge Niri) 
Civil Judge 
(Senior Division) 
Seppa
